changelog: OCR scanned PDFs using Tesseract. Rasterises pages at configurable DPI, then runs OCR with multi-language support (eng+hin, eng+fra, etc.). Returns per-page text with confidence scores and optional word-level bounding boxes.
summary: Extract text from scanned PDFs using Tesseract OCR. Supports multiple languages, page selection, DPI control, and word-level bounding boxes.
